notes.title: I'm against this marriage
notes.content:
This update
1. New social gameplay.
2. Changed the overall UI.
3. Added Matcha, the target of raiding.
4. New daughter growth plot and ending picture.
5. Added a new mouse romance.
6. Adjusted the fishing difficulty and price.
7. Fixed some bugs and misspellings.




Epilogue
It's not easy, I feel like I've been through a cold winter day. Although there are still 3 modules that were not added as expected, we are satisfied with it. The only regret is that in the original plan, we intended for the three families to apologise to each other. The farmer and the lemon apologised to each other, and the farmer apologised to his daughter, but we may never be able to wait for the daughter's apology, or maybe that's life. Even if we know that the daughter needs to say sorry to her father, that would be a great satisfaction, but that's as far as it goes for us. The shipwreck was too much to spend, budget or time, so this is the end of the game.

Thank you to those of you who have supported us all the way to the end. It may not have been a fun game to play, but we appreciate your patience and your serious comments.

So finally - see you soon!

notes.title: 《I'm against this marriage》 production schedule
notes.content:
I wanted to give you a quick update on the progress of the game so far. At the moment, there is not much progress on the game's social system (the program has made a chat system, but the UI may still need to be adjusted).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/a3ab1e0548a2ee80c25cf61c74f3b02a495ddb5e.png[/img]

In order to make the game more interesting, we will prepare more topics and options, especially this time we want to branch out and make the chat system interesting as well.

We want players to get to know their love interest or friends better through chatting. The amount of text in this section is very large, comparable to a novel system.

The picture below shows an early branch of a novel we wrote, a story with 32 endings, each with a different plot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/1556b7e5ec62a70f6de8a5dbf194909514de8250.png[/img]

The idea at the time was to have more freedom through the choice of everyone. The game has a total of 11 mini-episodes, with a total of 11 different ones. There are a total of 11 novels in the game, and players can write up to one in three months (this was also decided in view of the fact that novels are more profitable).

Then there's the friends feature. The UI below is not yet finalised and there is a lot to change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/71b585af246f9e2d7daf2544084c70c5acf6d8fa.png[/img]

In the official version there will be options for not only raiding objects and daughters (you can rush your daughter home) but also friends and strangers. We'll be adding more interactive aspects to the game, such as giving gifts to people's favourite things, and characters will be pictured in their friends' circle.

We will be redrawing props.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/ff9395f904352a207435a6abfa716d5ba6e513c3.png[/img]

Characters will be pictured if they like the player's gift (eh, right now we don't have a single picture drawn.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/a5eac7df2101643a19c7d8a0150496446453ff1d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/372934bbfd61cc4ab09eeec90bf96217a6f5e0a7.jpg[/img]

In addition to the gifts, the characters also post pictures and comments on a daily basis, so you can like them and get topics to chat with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/d08631540277b23583bd2a8cca452a2420fa7188.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/4eecff4085027102b310d3c07e05a0ad1c364d61.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963296/ab1b3038235c1714fd90a4b4b80e7d61cc58f39d.jpg[/img]

We're also going to change the final ending display, especially the daughter's ending, and probably add a lot of CG ....... We're not really good at drawing, which is the most time-consuming thing to do.

All in all, the system is too big (mainly in terms of material preparation) and it will probably be a few months before the next update. We also want to add a goodwill plot for the rats, and a rat-related CG.

However, we are still trying to work on the game step by step and we would like to thank everyone for their support.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: I'm Against This Marriage' updated fishing system
notes.content:
This update contains.
1. New courier storyline, and fishing ground location.
(The linkage was decided in order to make the career within job hunting, useful. Players will have no action after working as a courier, and can choose to quit when they are brushed out and can go fishing.)

2. New fishing game and fish selling.

3. New fishing icon and my trophy.

4. A new fishing competition has been added to the main line.
(Note: If you want to participate in the fishing competition, please do not sell all the fish, as you will not have any fish to take to the competition.)

5. New in-game achievements have been added and the achievements panel has been optimised.

7. New ending egg - Smart as a whip.

8. Optimized the class reunion and added three new friendship lines.

9. 5 new CGs have been added.

10. Directly open the marriage market.
(Bai Aoi needs to go to the detective agency, and as in the previous episode, Bai Aoi will not appear until after the park event is triggered according to the prompt.)

11. Newly added Mermaid as a raidable object.

12. Added buying a car to add action power.

13. Adjusted the initial warehouse and initial action power, as well as the work consuming action power.

14. Adjusted the main line time.

15. Modified some bugs: daughter's weight, marriage market can't be matched, etc.
